card: Fixes a node crash in the listtransactions wallet RPC caused by signed integer overflow when the sum of the count and skip arguments exceeds INT_MAX. On unpatched nodes, supplying count + skip >= 2^31 corrupts the loop termination and iterator bounds, crashing bitcoind. The PR widens the additions to int64_t and adds a functional test.
evidence: PR description documents a reproducible crash command `bitcoin-cli -regtest listtransactions "*" 2147483647 1` with UBSan reporting signed integer overflow at `transactions.cpp:584` followed by an ASan bus error in `UniValue::push_backV`.
PR description notes the included functional test reproduces the node crash on master and passes with the fix.
problem: Calling `listtransactions` with large non-negative `count` and `skip` parameters whose sum exceeds `INT_MAX` triggers signed integer overflow. This causes an invalid iterator range calculation and crashes the node with a bus error or segmentation fault.

risk.why: Mistakes in wallet RPC bounds checking could cause incorrect transaction listing or memory corruption, though the change is very small and targeted.

scope_notes: Small patch (+9/-2) fixing integer math in wallet RPC transaction listing and adding a functional regression test.
summary: Fix a signed integer overflow crash in the `listtransactions` RPC when the sum of `count` and `skip` exceeds `INT_MAX`. The additions are changed to use `int64_t`, and a functional test covering large parameter sums is added.
